May 7, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Ken Fisher increased its stake in Abb Ltd Adr (ABB) by 5.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fisher Asset Management Llc bought 515,119 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.59% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ken Fisher held 9.17M shares of the electrical products company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $246.04 million, up from 8.66M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fisher Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Abb Ltd Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $51.37 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.24% or $0.29 $23.73. About 419,901 shares traded. ABB Ltd (NYSE:ABB) has declined 0.51% downtrending. It has underperformed by 12.06% the S&P500.
Forte Capital Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.68% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Forte Capital Llc sold 2,474 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 89,996 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.23M, down from 92,470 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Forte Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $949.30B market cap company. The stock increased 1.77% or $3.26 $187.09. About 20.54 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
